const.name: descriptor_catalog
const.sql: CREATE TABLE descriptor_catalog (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version = 2), retainedBytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(retainedBytes) = 'integer' AND retainedBytes >= 0 AND retainedBytes <= 1073741824), retainedNodes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(retainedNodes) = 'integer' AND retainedNodes >= 0 AND retainedNodes <= 65536), nextOrdinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(nextOrdinal) = 'integer' AND nextOrdinal >= 0 AND nextOrdinal <= 9007199254740991))

const.name: descriptor_node
const.sql: CREATE TABLE descriptor_node (ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (ordinal >= 0 AND ordinal < 9007199254740991), digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(digest) = 64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'), bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(bytes) = 'integer' AND bytes >= 1 AND bytes <= 16777216))

const.name: descriptor_insert
const.sql: CREATE TRIGGER descriptor_insert AFTER INSERT ON descriptor_node BEGIN UPDATE descriptor_catalog SET retainedBytes = retainedBytes + NEW.bytes, retainedNodes = retainedNodes + 1, nextOrdinal = MAX(nextOrdinal, NEW.ordinal + 1) WHERE id = 1; END

const.name: descriptor_delete
const.sql: CREATE TRIGGER descriptor_delete AFTER DELETE ON descriptor_node BEGIN UPDATE descriptor_catalog SET retainedBytes = retainedBytes - OLD.bytes, retainedNodes = retainedNodes - 1 WHERE id = 1; END

const.name: descriptor_immutable
const.sql: CREATE TRIGGER descriptor_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON descriptor_node BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Immutable descriptor entry'); END
